verdict.rationale: The pack has no affirmative content showing that Datadog turns a natural-language question about telemetry into a real query or chart. The 'Bits AI' and 'Datadog MCP Server' items are page titles only and describe no natural-language querying. The ChatGPT Experiments plugin covers experiment analysis, which is adjacent to telemetry querying rather than this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask questions of my telemetry in natural language and get a real query or chart back
